findings.detail: The pct-of-net-assets identity check appears to use the wrong internal denominator; source rows tie to Net Assets of 435,763,591 after normal percent rounding.

rationale: Raw source shows the SOI denominator explicitly as Net Assets (100.0%) of 435,763,591. The same schedule reports Total Investments of 1,198,298,004 as 275.0%, which independently implies the same net-assets scale after filing rounding. Flagged rows such as Tabhi Purchaser Term Loan B show 13.0% and fair value 56,634,539, which equals about 13.0% of 435,763,591. The large residuals therefore arise from the checker/internal anchor, not from erroneous source values.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Tabhi Purchaser, LLC (fka Mondee Holdings LLC) Term Loan B - 9.67% inc PIK | 13.0% | Fair Value 56,634,539
